reason: Native provider adapters and the skill guide had wire-level defects the existing tests never exercised. Only the Chat Completions adapter mapped dotted Nebula tool names (tool_output.search, workspace.read, nebula.finish_task) through _wire_tool_names, so every tool turn on the OpenAI Responses, Anthropic and Bedrock adapters was rejected by the vendor name rule [a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}; those adapters now encode tool definitions and replayed calls and decode the names on returned calls. The Responses adapter also sent strict:true for every strict tool even when the schema had optional properties, defaults or uniqueItems that OpenAI strict mode rejects, and forwarded temperature to o-series/gpt-5 models that answer 400 for it; strict is now sent only when _openai_strict_schema accepts the schema and temperature is dropped for reasoning families. Gemini generateContent function calls carry no id, which failed ToolCall validation as a malformed call; the adapter now synthesises a stable id per response and index and omits synthesised ids on replay. Bedrock stringified multimodal messages (the image was dropped and its base64 billed as text); a _bedrock_content translator now emits Converse text and image blocks. Anthropic and Gemini model discovery read only the first page (20 and 50 rows); health() now follows has_more/after_id and nextPageToken, bounded to 20 pages, and no longer KeyErrors on a model row without id/name. On the skill side the guide starter SKILL.md linked a checklist.md that was never written, so the created skill could not be selected; the starter now writes checklist.md. A link with a whitespace-only target raised IndexError instead of a validation error, and OSError text with the host path reached the UI from the project-instructions probe and the skills listing; both now go through scrub_host_paths, the public form of the operator_detail scrub. tests/v3/test_providers.py adds wire-name/strict/temperature tests for Responses, Anthropic and Bedrock, the Bedrock image-block test, the Gemini synthetic-id test, the Anthropic/Gemini pagination tests and the health id-guard test; tests/v3/test_guides.py checks the starter is selectable and that the instructions error hides paths; tests/v3/test_skill_catalog.py covers the empty link target and the scrubbed 409 detail. Every new test fails on main. Note: test_openrouter_verified_key_does_not_hide_catalog_failure_or_use_public_models in tests/v3/test_providers.py already fails on origin/main at 66d5ca9 (#428 retries the /models/user 429 to exhaustion inside _openrouter_health); it is outside this change and is left for its own fix. Rebased onto main after #444: that change owns the streaming and error-classification helpers, this one owns the adapter payloads, and the conflicting test file keeps both sides' new tests (101 collected, all green).
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change (the guide overlay only opens paths[0], which is still SKILL.md). No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through src/nebula/v3/api.py) does not exercise provider wire payloads, model discovery pagination or the skill starter link; the Python tests drive them directly with httpx.MockTransport, a stubbed boto3 client and TestClient. No full suites.
